trial_court: Court of Sh. Ankit Mittal: Civil Judge-01, South West District: Dwarka Court: New Delhi (Case No. 381/24)

parties.respondent_defendant: Ms. Rani, wife of son of plaintiff

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Plaintiff is landlord/owner of three-storied house property. Defendant is wife of plaintiff's son. Plaintiff allowed defendant to live in one room on first floor. Defendant never acceded to request to live with son permanently.

legal_principles.principle: A person's right to maintenance is a fundamental right.
legal_principles.held: It is further submitted that the daughter of the Defendant also has all the right to be maintained by the Plaintiff, being her granddaughter and the Plaintiff cannot shy away from such responsibility after the death of her father, i.e., the son of the Plaintiff.

legal_principles.principle: A person's matrimonial home is their own property.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the above-mentioned one room set is a matrimonial home of Defendant where she cohabited with her husband, i.e., the Plaintiff's son after the solemnization of their marriage and cannot be treated as licensed premises by stretch of any imagination.

outcome.final_order: Court granted mandatory and permanent injunction and recovery of mesne profit.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: representing a tenant in eviction proceedings
